characters.name: ブリティッシュショートヘア
characters.description: 青灰色の毛、銅色の目。レアモビー参照の修正版。

characters.name: シャム（シールポイント）
characters.description: クリーム色と濃茶のポイント、青い目。レアモビー参照の修正版。

characters.name: ベンガル
characters.description: 金茶のロゼット模様、黄緑色の目。

characters.name: ラグドール
characters.description: 白と青灰色のバイカラー、長めの毛、青い目。

characters.name: アメリカンショートヘア
characters.description: Silver classic tabby American Shorthair: short dense silver fur, very bold charcoal swirling bullseye flank markings, forehead M, ringed tail, green iris.

characters.name: スコティッシュフォールド
characters.description: Cream Scottish Fold: distinctly small folded-forward downturned ears hugging round head, warm pale apricot short dense coat, amber iris.

characters.name: メインクーン
characters.description: Brown tabby Maine Coon: tall ears with lynx-tip tufts, shaggy long fur, pronounced neck ruff and square muzzle, dark brown tabby stripes, golden-green iris, large plume tail.

characters.name: ノルウェージャンフォレストキャット
characters.description: Norwegian Forest cat: red tabby and white, long flowing guard hairs, thick white chest ruff, tufted ears, fluffy tail, green iris.

characters.name: ペルシャ
characters.description: White Persian: exceptionally long dense white fluffy coat, small low-set ears, gently flattened short nose and round cheeks, copper iris, huge soft plume tail.

characters.name: バリニーズ
characters.description: Lilac-point Balinese: ivory silky semi-long hair, pale pink-grey mask ears feet and fine plume tail, sapphire blue iris; pointed pattern clearly visible.

characters.name: ロシアンブルー
characters.description: Russian Blue: close short plush blue-grey fur with silver tipped sheen, large upright ears, emerald green iris, slender tail; avoid long shaggy coat.

characters.name: アビシニアン
characters.description: Ruddy Abyssinian: warm reddish-brown ticked short fur with dark dorsal shading, no stripes or spots on torso, large upright ears, gold iris, cream chin.

characters.name: ソマリ
characters.description: Sorrel Somali: rich cinnamon-red ticked semi-long fur, foxlike warm red ear tufts, thick neck ruff and bushy fox tail, green iris, pale peach muzzle.

characters.name: ターキッシュアンゴラ
characters.description: White Turkish Angora: fine silky flowing white semi-long fur, large upright ears, delicate pointed muzzle, long fine plume tail, sapphire blue iris.

characters.name: ターキッシュバン
characters.description: Red-and-white Turkish Van: almost all white semi-long fur, red patches restricted mainly to crown near ears, red ringed plume tail, amber iris.

characters.name: サイベリアン
characters.description: Siberian: thick plush triple-coat brown mackerel tabby, cream muzzle and chest, rounded tufted ears, broad soft muzzle, thick bushy tail, yellow-green iris.

characters.name: トンキニーズ
characters.description: Champagne mink Tonkinese: short silky warm beige fur, milk-chocolate face ears feet tail with softly blended contrast, luminous aqua turquoise iris.

characters.name: エキゾチックショートヘア
characters.description: Red tabby Exotic Shorthair: dense velvety short orange coat with darker red stripes, extremely round cheeks, very short flat nose, small rounded ears, copper iris.

characters.name: バーマン
characters.description: Seal-point Birman: long silky cream coat, dark seal face mask and ears, conspicuous white gloves on both hands and feet, dark plume tail, deep blue iris.

characters.name: ラガマフィン
characters.description: Ragamuffin: soft very fluffy semi-long calico coat with white belly and muzzle, large distinct orange and black patches, gentle rounded face, hazel gold iris, fluffy calico tail.

characters.name: アメリカンカール
characters.description: American Curl: unmistakable ears curling backward at the tips, silver tabby and white semi-long coat, white muzzle/chest/feet, green iris, plume tail.

characters.name: セルカークレックス
characters.description: Selkirk Rex: visibly curly woolly cream coat with tight loose ringlets especially cheeks and torso, curly whiskers, normal small upright ears, copper iris.

characters.name: デボンレックス
characters.description: Devon Rex: short soft wavy smoke-grey fur, very large low-set broad ears, pixie face with prominent cheekbones, large green iris; retain furry rounded-square Mobby body.

characters.name: コーニッシュレックス
characters.description: Cornish Rex: fine short coat with distinct rippled marcel waves, warm white and ginger bicolor, very tall upright ears, curved whiskers, amber iris; Mobby body stays square.

characters.name: ジャパニーズボブテイル
characters.description: Japanese Bobtail: mi-ke tricolor white with separate red-orange and black patches, short sleek fur, upright ears, small bunny pompom bobtail visible at side instead of long tail, gold iris.

characters.name: マンクス
characters.description: Manx: dense short black-and-white tuxedo coat, white muzzle/chest/belly and feet, NO tail at all, rounded ears, gold iris.

characters.name: エジプシャンマウ
characters.description: Silver Egyptian Mau: silver short silky fur with separated solid black small spots, forehead scarab M marking, striped neck and ringed tail, gooseberry green iris, no rosettes.

characters.name: オシキャット
characters.description: Tawny Ocicat: smooth short warm tawny coat with neat large solid chocolate thumbprint spots in rows, striped legs and ringed tail, golden iris, no rosettes.

characters.name: トイガー
characters.description: Toyger: vivid rich orange short fur with bold irregular vertical branching black TIGER STRIPES on body and circular facial markings, white muzzle/belly, amber iris, dark ringed tail.

characters.name: シンガプーラ
characters.description: Singapura: pale warm ivory sepia agouti ticked short coat, dark brown fine ticking, large gently cupped ears, very large green iris, dark nose outline, small cream muzzle.

characters.name: バーミーズ
characters.description: Sable Burmese: rich uniformly deep warm sable-brown glossy short fur, rounded ears and cheeks, golden yellow iris, subtly lighter muzzle, dark brown tail.

characters.name: ボンベイ
characters.description: Bombay: solid jet-black short sleek glossy fur with subtle clear strand detail, rounded ears, brilliant copper orange iris, black nose and tail; make black controls readable through lighting.

characters.name: ハバナブラウン
characters.description: Havana Brown: solid warm reddish chocolate glossy short fur, distinct brown nose and matching brown whiskers, upright ears, vivid emerald green iris, softly squared muzzle.

characters.name: スノーシュー
characters.description: Snowshoe: short seal-point bicolor fur, clear white inverted V on face, white chest/belly and all four white paws, dark seal ears and tail, bright blue iris, short smooth fur unlike Ragdoll.

characters.name: れあもびー
characters.description: 既存のレアモビー。茶と黒の三毛風（キジ三毛）のふわふわ長毛、黄緑の目、首に茶色の首輪と丸いタグ。

characters.name: うゆもびー
characters.description: 既存のうゆもびー。ベージュにグレーの縞が入ったふわふわの毛、白い生体の目、首に小さな鈴付きの数珠の首輪。
